svg.aria-label: Twelve Attune Conversation colorways with hex swatches
svg.text: Calm blue with a sunny point of connection.
Soft lavender with a warm yellow lift.
Friendly coral, peach, and deep blue ink.
Fresh green, gentle sage, and golden light.
Muted sea glass with an earthy accent.
Expressive berry softened by rose and butter.
Grounded neutrals with an inviting peach glow.
Playful violet balanced by a soft coral accent.
A warm earth-and-sky pairing with clear contrast.
High-energy lime and mint against midnight ink.
